notes: prs_rejected_by_maintainer = closed-unmerged PRs to repos not owned by the user whose last ClosedEvent actor is not the author (ghost/unknown actor counts as maintainer)

user_commits: max of the monthly contributionsCollection commit counts over ALL contribution years, the GraphQL default-branch history totalCount (author = user id) and REST /contributors page 1 (top 25 repos only; anonymous entries named like the login/profile name are added to the login's count); excludes commits GitHub could not link to the account
user_additions/deletions: summed from up to 60 detailed merged PRs per user, scaled to user_merged_prs when sampled (additions_estimated=true)
first/last_contrib_at are month granularity (contribution graph months, PR creation months, GraphQL history commit dates of up to 300 commits)

adoption: forks, contributors_total, issue_authors (last 50 issues) and dependents (ecosyste.ms dependent_packages_count) for the top 25 repos; package downloads, release downloads, Docker pulls and Homebrew installs are not collected

user_rank / contributors_total: REST /contributors?anon=1 page 1 (users + anonymous emails) for the top 25 repos by priority; rank = position of the first matched entry in the first 100 (null beyond), total from the Link rel=last page; null when not fetched or the endpoint fails (e.g. 403 on huge repos)
v11 backfill: maintainer fields added to older data (existing repos only)

v15 gap fill: GH Archive gap months (daily rate < 50% of the trailing median, last 24 months): reviews 2026-05/2026-06/2026-07/2026-08, comments 2026-05/2026-06/2026-07/2026-08, merged 2025-10/2025-11/2026-05/2026-06/2026-07/2026-08, closes 2026-05/2026-06/2026-07/2026-08; 0 verified-role repos (≤ 15) checked against the GitHub API, 0 raised in months none (reviews: contributionsCollection; comments: user.issueComments, inline review comments not covered; merges of others' PRs and issue closes: search repo:R closed:<month> (≤ 100 items; larger months: + involves:<login>, a lower bound)); per family max(GH Archive, API)

star_history (v15): weekly star gains from GET /repos/{r}/stargazers/history (API 2026-03-10) for 0 owned/led non-fork repos (top 10 by stars ≥ 50 plus all ≥ 1000, ≤ 25); [date of the Sunday week start, gain], zero weeks omitted; for rule F only, never scored

v15 backfill: maint_* re-derived (GH Archive 'merged' events, gap months filled from the GitHub API; existing repos only), dependents/dependent_repos (repository_url + same-owner name lookup) for the repos with adoption signals, last_push_at, star_history
